prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent illustration of a personal music trophy for a mobile app.
Style: premium tactile 3D miniature sculpture matching a burnt-orange enamel vintage turntable, polished enamel, midnight-black vinyl grooves, softly brushed silver, dark-plum pedestal. Warm studio illumination, art-directed beautiful object, charming rather than a generic sports cup.
Composition: one entire award centered, front three-quarter view, distinct readable silhouette at 120px, transparent alpha and soft contact shadow only.
Palette: #ed642f orange, #62354b plum, #f7f0e7 cream, #edc9d7 pink, #242426 black, brushed silver.
Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, stars, sparkle icons, laurels, logos, watermark, people, UI, scene or background. Keep the trophy's semantic object unmistakable.
Subject: a vintage silver ribbed microphone with a rose-pink enamel grille and an orange curved support, mounted on a dark-plum pedestal with a tiny black vinyl inset. This specifically represents singing / vocal / lyrical music awards.
derivative: Resized to 640px (player) or 320px (trophy), WebP quality 88; alpha preserved.
